A Letter From Daniyal (Mamu)

A Birthday Letter For You 💌

Meri Pyari Rida, ❤️

Aaj ka din aapke liye bohat special hai. Mere liye aap sirf meri bhanji nahi, balkay meri zindagi ki un pyari khushiyon mein se ek hain jo har cheez ko aur khoobsurat bana deti hain. 🤲🏻✨

Allah Pak aapki zindagi ko hamesha khushiyon, sehat, sukoon aur barkaton se bhar de. Aap hamesha isi tarah muskurati rahen, khub seekhein, khub khush rahen aur har naya din aapke liye pyari yaadein lekar aaye. 🌸

Allah aapko buri nazar se mehfooz rakhe aur aapki har achi dua qubool farmaye. Ameen. 🤍

Happy 6th Birthday, Rida! 🎂💗
